_comment: Procedural table for Items. weaponSkill keys and damageMin/damageMax are NOT authored here -- lib/proceduralGenerators.js rolls those from lib/itemFormulas.js's WEAPON_ROLL_RANGES/clampDamageRange at generation time, per procedural_generation_scope_proposal.md #4. Same for armor: effectorTierRange picks a tier, computeArmorDR() derives the DR number. rarityWeights is a per-row weighted pool the generator uses to pick THIS item's rarity; the top-level 'weight' on each row controls how often that row is picked at all relative to its siblings. Every row in weapons/armor/consumables/questItems, and every row in pools.condition, carries a 'genre' array (post_apoc/fantasy/scifi/modern/horror, or 'universal') that lib/proceduralGenerators.js's filterByGenre() uses to keep procedural content in-genre for the world it's generated into -- see that file's 'Genre awareness' section header comment for the full mechanism. pools.appliesStatus/rarityEffect/designNotes are NOT genre-filtered and intentionally carry no genre field.

consumables.name: Antivenin (uncertain origin)
consumables.effect: Clears one Poison or Corruption stack.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A vial of antivenin with no label at all, {condition}, works better than it should.

consumables.name: Calming Charm (real)
consumables.effect: Clears one Fear or Panic status and grants brief Fate resistance.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A small charm on a cord, {condition}, goes cold to the touch the moment it's needed.

consumables.name: Sinew Thread Spool
consumables.effect: Restores a chunk of a broken machine's or ally's shield/armor durability.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A spool of thread that isn't quite thread, {condition}, holds a seam unnervingly well.

consumables.name: Clarity Tincture (bitter)
consumables.effect: Grants a Knowledge-based skill check bonus for the rest of the scene.
consumables.flavorTemplate: A tincture that tastes like old pennies, {condition}, focuses the mind at a cost you can't quite name.

questItems.name: Sealed Manifest
questItems.flavorTemplate: A wax-sealed shipping manifest, {condition}, listing cargo that officially never existed.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whoever sealed this wanted it to survive them -- the wax seal alone is worth more than the paper it's protecting.

questItems.name: Keyed Data Chit
questItems.flavorTemplate: A palm-sized data chit, {condition}, keyed to a lock nobody's found yet.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}, still warm from whatever it was last plugged into. Someone is going to want this back.

questItems.name: Faded Photograph
questItems.flavorTemplate: A photograph, {condition}, of people who don't look like they knew what was coming.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Tucked away at {locationLine}. Nothing written on the back -- whoever kept it assumed they'd remember.

questItems.name: Broken Locket
questItems.flavorTemplate: A locket with the hinge snapped, {condition}, hinge repaired at least once before that.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Pulled from the wreckage at {locationLine}. It was worth fixing once. Someone thought it was worth carrying even broken.

questItems.name: Corporate Access Badge
questItems.flavorTemplate: A laminated badge, {condition}, photo scratched off but the clearance level still legible.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. The clearance level printed on it opens doors that shouldn't still be powered.

questItems.name: Hand-Drawn Map Fragment
questItems.flavorTemplate: A torn corner of a hand-drawn map, {condition}, marked with symbols that match nothing official.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. It's only a fragment -- whatever the rest of the map showed, this piece alone raises more questions than it answers.

questItems.name: Signal Beacon (dead)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A handheld beacon, {condition}, battery long dead but the antenna still extended.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Somebody was trying to call for help, or call something in -- there's no way to tell from the beacon alone.

questItems.name: Ledger Page
questItems.flavorTemplate: A single ledger page, {condition}, columns of names and numbers in a cramped hand.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Torn loose at {locationLine}. Whatever this page was tracking, somebody didn't want the rest of the ledger found alongside it.

questItems.name: Sealed Royal Decree
questItems.flavorTemplate: A wax-sealed royal decree, {condition}, bearing a signet nobody currently on the throne would recognize.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whatever this decree ordered, the order predates every living memory of why.

questItems.name: Shattered Rune-Stone
questItems.flavorTemplate: A fist-sized stone shard etched with half a rune, {condition}, warm despite the season.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. The rune is incomplete -- whatever it was meant to do, it never finished doing it.

questItems.name: Knight's Broken Signet Ring
questItems.flavorTemplate: A signet ring with the band snapped, {condition}, crest filed away by someone who wanted to disappear.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Pulled from {locationLine}. Someone worked hard to stop being who this ring says they were.

questItems.name: Pressed Wildflower Journal Page
questItems.flavorTemplate: A journal page with a pressed wildflower still tucked inside, {condition}, ink smudged at the corner.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Tucked away at {locationLine}. The flower has long outlasted whoever pressed it.

questItems.name: Temple Offering Bowl
questItems.flavorTemplate: A small bronze offering bowl, {condition}, coins still stuck to the bottom.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Nobody's cleared the offerings in longer than they should have left them.

questItems.name: Fragmented Prophecy Tablet
questItems.flavorTemplate: A clay tablet with half its prophecy chipped away, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. What remains of the prophecy is just specific enough to be dangerous.

questItems.name: Noble House Seal
questItems.flavorTemplate: A wax-stamping seal for a noble house, {condition}, the house's fortunes long since changed.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. This seal could still open doors, for better or worse.

questItems.name: Bound Grimoire Fragment
questItems.flavorTemplate: A few loose pages torn from a larger grimoire, {condition}, bound with a leather cord.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. Whatever book these came from, the rest of it is still out there.

questItems.name: Encrypted Data Core
questItems.flavorTemplate: A palm-sized encrypted data core, {condition}, casing still warm from active storage.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}, still drawing trickle power from somewhere. Someone encrypted this for a reason.

questItems.name: Derelict Ship's Manifest Chip
questItems.flavorTemplate: A manifest chip pulled from a derelict vessel, {condition}, listing cargo the ship's registry never mentioned.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. The manifest and the ship's official log don't match.

questItems.name: Sealed Cryo-Vial (occupant unknown)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A sealed cryo-vial, {condition}, contents indistinct behind frosted glass.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whatever's inside is still, technically, alive.

questItems.name: Corrupted AI Core Fragment
questItems.flavorTemplate: A fragment of an AI core, {condition}, occasionally flickers with residual process activity.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Pulled from the wreckage at {locationLine}. It shouldn't still be thinking. It might still be thinking.

questItems.name: Alien Artifact (inert)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A smooth artifact of unknown alien manufacture, {condition}, material unlike anything catalogued.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Every attempt to identify its function has failed so far.

questItems.name: Corporate Clearance Chip
questItems.flavorTemplate: A corporate clearance chip, {condition}, credentials scrubbed but the access tier intact.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. The clearance tier on this chip opens doors that shouldn't still be live.

questItems.name: Distress Beacon Log
questItems.flavorTemplate: A logged distress beacon, {condition}, still looping the same automated message.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. The beacon has been calling for help long after anyone was left to answer.

questItems.name: Genome Sample Case
questItems.flavorTemplate: A sealed genome sample case, {condition}, refrigeration unit still faintly humming.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Someone thought this sample was worth keeping cold no matter what.

questItems.name: Locked Diary
questItems.flavorTemplate: A locked diary with a small brass clasp, {condition}, key long since lost.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Whatever's written inside was worth locking away, even from family.

questItems.name: USB Drive (labeled by hand)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A USB drive with a hand-written label, {condition}, plastic casing scuffed from a keyring.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. The label raises more questions than it answers.

questItems.name: Old Employee ID Badge
questItems.flavorTemplate: An expired employee ID badge, {condition}, photo faded but the name still legible.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. The company on this badge closed years before anyone here was born.

questItems.name: Safety Deposit Box Key
questItems.flavorTemplate: A small brass safety deposit box key, {condition}, box number stamped on the shank.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Somewhere, a bank still has the matching box.

questItems.name: Wedding Ring (engraved)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A wedding ring engraved with initials and a date, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Nobody wears a ring like this and just walks away from it.

questItems.name: Answering Machine Tape
questItems.flavorTemplate: A cassette tape from an old answering machine, {condition}, label just says a first name.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered at {locationLine}. There's no way to know how long that message has been waiting.

questItems.name: Newspaper Clipping (folded)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A newspaper clipping folded until the creases nearly tore through, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Whoever kept this read it enough times to memorize it.

questItems.name: Motel Room Key (physical)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A physical motel room key on a plastic fob, {condition}, motel name half worn off.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. The motel on the fob may or may not still be standing.

questItems.name: Sealed Reliquary Box
questItems.flavorTemplate: A small sealed reliquary box, {condition}, latch cold enough to sting bare skin.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whatever's inside, the seal was clearly meant to keep something in, not out.

questItems.name: Child's Drawing (wrong details)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A child's crayon drawing, {condition}, of a familiar place with one detail that's very wrong.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Nobody remembers a child living here.

questItems.name: Jar of Teeth
questItems.flavorTemplate: A jar of teeth that don't all match the same mouth, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Somebody was keeping count of something.

questItems.name: Recording of an Unfamiliar Voice
questItems.flavorTemplate: A recording device looping a voice nobody present recognizes, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. The voice says a name. It's not anyone's name here.

questItems.name: Cracked Mirror Shard
questItems.flavorTemplate: A shard of mirror that reflects a half-second late, {condition}.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Watch it long enough and you'll notice the delay yourself.

questItems.name: Effigy Doll (stitched)
questItems.flavorTemplate: A crude stitched effigy doll, {condition}, a lock of real hair sewn into the scalp.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Somebody made this to represent a real person.

questItems.name: Autopsy Report (unfinished)
questItems.flavorTemplate: An unfinished autopsy report, {condition}, the cause-of-death field left conspicuously blank.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Recovered from {locationLine}. Whoever was writing this stopped mid-sentence and never came back.

questItems.name: Warded Iron Nail Bundle
questItems.flavorTemplate: A bundle of iron nails bound with red thread, {condition}, placed with obvious intent.
questItems.whereFoundTemplate: Found at {locationLine}. Somebody nailed something shut, or nailed something down.

Uncommon.value: Deals +1 damage against the Bleed status.
Grants +5% accuracy on the first attack each combat.
Recovers a small amount of Energy on a critical hit.

Rare.value: Deals bonus damage against enemies already suffering a status effect.
On a critical hit, applies a second, weaker instance of its status.
+10% accuracy and +5% crit chance while wielded.
Reduces the AP cost of the wielder's first ability each combat by 1.

Legendary.value: Once per combat, the next attack made with this cannot miss.
Damage scales with the wielder's missing health -- the worse things look, the harder it hits.
Applies its status on every hit, not just criticals, for the rest of the encounter after the first kill.
